claim_boundary: This gate demonstrates a closed toy operator loop with quasi-active dendritic purification, a reciprocal small-signal baseline, an AIS-state-conditioned return receipt, a receipt-and-eligibility-gated local structural edit, and changed replay after fast-state erasure. It is not a fitted AIS/bAP/STDP model and does not show that biological bAPs compute an adjoint or exact gradient.
